title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1 League in Irvine, California, as the "Tuskegee Airman Lieutenant Colonel Robert J. Friend Memorial Post Office Building".
official_summary: This bill designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1 League in Irvine, California, as the Tuskegee Airman Lieutenant Colonel Robert J. Friend Memorial Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A federal law renames a Post Office building in Irvine, California, after a Tuskegee Airman, Lieutenant Colonel Robert J. Friend.
summary.what_it_does: The law officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1 League in Irvine, California, the Tuskegee Airman Lieutenant Colonel Robert J. Friend Memorial Post Office Building. It is a naming measure and does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 23, 2022.
